knowledge:
- key_parameters: isNested=TRUE ;; Enables nesting of graphs into containers when using addGraphToRedeR ;; gcoord=guidance ;; Numeric vector specifying the xy-coordinates for placing a nested graph container ;; gscale=guidance ;; Numeric value defining the expansion factor or size of the graph container ;; zoom=guidance ;; Numeric value in [0, 100] specifying the zoom scale of the visualization ;; p1 to p9=guidance ;; Parameters in relaxRedeR controlling the interactive force-directed layout algorithm ;; refcol=guidance ;; Column index in the input data frame used for mapping identifiers to graph vertices in att.mapv or subg (use refcol = 0 for row names) ;; checkJava=TRUE ;; Parameter in RedPort to verify that the system meets the Java Runtime Environment requirement (Java >= 11)
- alternatives: TreeAndLeaf ;; Used to convert hierarchical clustering (hclust) objects into tree-and-leaf diagrams before visualization in RedeR ;; igraph ;; Used for general network representation and layout generation, which RedeR extends
- when_to_use: When visualizing modular, hierarchical, or nested biological networks (such as pathways, differentially expressed genes across multiple time points, or overlapping functional groups) ;; When displaying tree-and-leaf diagrams to improve the visualization of dendrogram leaves combined with force-directed layouts
- pitfalls: Java version ;; RedeR >= 3.0.0 requires Java Runtime Environment (JRE) version 11 or higher; failing to meet this requirement will cause the R-to-Java interface to fail ;; Missing vertex names ;; Functions like att.addv and att.adde require that the vertices in the igraph object are named (V(g)$name must be populated) ;; Unmatched genes ;; When extracting subgraphs using subg, some genes in the dataset might not be present in the reference interactome, which triggers a warning but is expected

workflows.name: nested_subgraphs
workflows.intent: Extract differentially expressed genes from multiple time points, map expression values to node colors, nest them into hierarchical containers, and visualize overlapping genes.
input: hs.inter (igraph object representing a reference interactome)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize the RedeR application and reset the port ;; 2. Extract subgraphs for each time-point contrast using subg ;; 3. Map gene symbols to node labels and logFC values to node colors using att.setv ;; 4. Set container labels on the subgraphs ;; 5. Send the subgraphs to RedeR as nested containers using addGraphToRedeR ;; 6. Nest overlapping nodes into sub-containers using nestNodes ;; 7. Assign edges to containers using mergeOutEdges ;; 8. Run the interactive layout using relaxRedeR ;; 9. Add a color legend using addLegendToRedeR ;; 10. Select and highlight specific nodes using selectNodes
workflows.code:
library("RedeR")
library("igraph")
# startRedeR()
resetRedeR()
data(ER.limma)
data(hs.inter)
deg.t3 <- ER.limma[ER.limma$degenes.t3!=0,]
gt3 <- subg(g=hs.inter, dat=deg.t3, refcol=1)
gt3 <- att.setv(g=gt3, from="Symbol", to="nodeLabel")
gt3 <- att.setv(g=gt3, from="logFC.t3", to="nodeColor", 
  breaks=seq(-2,2,0.4), pal=2)
deg.t6 <- ER.limma[ER.limma$degenes.t6!=0,]
gt6 <- subg(g=hs.inter, dat=deg.t6, refcol=1)
gt6 <- att.setv(g=gt6, from="Symbol", to="nodeLabel")
gt6 <- att.setv(g=gt6, from="logFC.t6", to="nodeColor",
  breaks=seq(-2,2,0.4), pal=2)
deg.t12 <- ER.limma[ER.limma$degenes.t12!=0,]
gt12 <- subg(g=hs.inter, dat=deg.t12, refcol=1)
gt12 <- att.setv(g=gt12, from="Symbol", to="nodeLabel")
gt12 <- att.setv(g=gt12, from="logFC.t12", to="nodeColor", 
  breaks=seq(-2,2,0.4), pal=2)
gt3$nestLabel <- "3h"
gt6$nestLabel <- "6h"
gt12$nestLabel <- "12h"
N1 <- addGraphToRedeR(gt3, gcoord=c(10,25), gscale=20, 
  isNested=TRUE, theme='th1', zoom=30)
N2 <- addGraphToRedeR(gt6, gcoord=c(20,70), gscale=50, 
  isNested=TRUE, theme='th1', zoom=30)
N3 <- addGraphToRedeR(gt12, gcoord=c(70,55), gscale=80, 
  isNested=TRUE, theme='th1', zoom=30)
N4 <- nestNodes(nodes=V(gt3)$name, parent=N2, theme='th2')
N5 <- nestNodes(nodes=V(gt3)$name, parent=N3, theme='th2')
nestNodes(nodes=V(gt3)$name, parent=N5, theme='th2')
mergeOutEdges(nlevels=2)
relaxRedeR(p1=100, p2=100, p3=5, p4=150, 
  p5=5, p8=10, p9=20)
scl <- gt3$legNodeColor$scale
names(scl) <- gt3$legNodeColor$legend 
addLegendToRedeR(scl, type="nodecolor",
  title="Node color (logFC)", stretch = 0.1)
selectNodes("RET")

workflows.name: tree_and_leaf_diagrams
workflows.intent: Convert a hierarchical clustering object into a tree-and-leaf diagram, map experimental variables to node colors and sizes, and visualize it using a force-directed layout.
input: iris (data.frame of sample measurements and species classifications)
workflows.stages: 1. Perform hierarchical clustering on the input dataset using hclust ;; 2. Convert the hclust object into a tree-and-leaf igraph object using treeAndLeaf ;; 3. Map dataset variables to the tree-and-leaf graph using att.mapv ;; 4. Set node colors and sizes based on variables using att.setv ;; 5. Clear node labels and set edge colors using igraph shortcuts ;; 6. Send the tree-and-leaf graph to RedeR using addGraphToRedeR ;; 7. Anchor inner (non-leaf) nodes using selectNodes with anchor=TRUE ;; 8. Fine-tune the layout of leaf nodes using relaxRedeR ;; 9. Add legends for node color and size using addLegendToRedeR
workflows.code:
library("RedeR")
library("igraph")
library("TreeAndLeaf")
#startRedeR()
resetRedeR()
hc_iris <- hclust(dist(iris[,-5]))
tal <- treeAndLeaf(hc_iris)
tal <- att.mapv(g = tal, dat = iris, refcol = 0)
cols <- c("#80b1d3","#fb8072","#8dd3c7")
tal <- att.setv(tal, from="Species", to="nodeColor", cols=cols)
tal <- att.setv(tal, from="Species", to="nodeLineColor", cols=cols)	
tal <- att.setv(tal, from="Petal.Width", to="nodeSize", nquant=6, xlim=c(5,50,1))
V(tal)$nodeLabel <- ""
E(tal)$edgeLineColor <- "grey70"
addGraphToRedeR(tal, zoom=50)
selectNodes(V(tal)$name[!V(tal)$isLeaf], anchor=TRUE)
relaxRedeR(p1=10, p2=100, p3=5, p4=120, p5=1, p6=100)
addLegendToRedeR(tal, type="nodecolor", title="Species", stretch=0.2)
addLegendToRedeR(tal, type="nodesize", title="PetalWidth")
